answer: One defense is the synchronized pseudonym gathering: at a single fixed instant the network convenes simultaneous in-person meetups across regions — an orchard clearing in one zone, a lotus garden in another, a canyon trail in a third — and each participant can be witnessed at only one site. Since one body occupies one place at that shared moment, an operator claiming a thousand agents still earns just a single admission credential per round, so sybil multitudes collapse to one honest vote.
